title: History - Brückner Textile Machinery
content: In order to be able to optimally design and improve the website, we use cookies. Your express consent is required for the use of cookies. Kurt Brückner establishes Brückner Klimatechnik GmbH in Stuttgart, a small engineering office. Main products are air conditioning units and small dryers for the paper and textile industry, which are produced externally according to BRÜCKNER engineering drawings. The first small production plant is established in a rented factory floor in Stuttgart. Brückner builds and supplies to a German customer their first complete drying line for textiles. From now on the Development, the Design and Sales divisions are located in Leonberg. A new production site is established in Tittmoning/Bavaria since the hall in Leonberg is no longer sufficient and there is not enough labour available. From now on only smaller components are produced in Leonberg, the main part of the machines is built in Tittmoning. In Erbach/Odenwald Kurt Brückner takes over a machine factory producing dyeing machines and establishes the company BRÜCKNER Apparatebau GmbH.

title: History and High Points - Brückner Group
content: What began as a medium-sized enterprise has grown into a global technology leader with firm roots, sustainable growth, and a spirit of curiosity and openness. Our four specialized business units – Brückner Maschinenbau, Brückner Servtec, Hennecke, Kiefel, and PackSys Global – bring together in-depth expertise in film manufacturing, servicing, industrial processing of PUR, thermoforming, and packaging. The founding of Paul Kiefel GmbH marks the first chapter in the story of a company that would become an integral part of the Brückner Group. What began as a small mechanical engineering firm laid the foundation for decades of technological expertise in plastic processing. In the following decades, the company evolves from a purely manufacturing business into a global engineering firm. With the inception of Brückner Far East, the company takes a visionary step into Asian markets. With Brückner Colombia, the Group takes its global presence into South America for the first time.
